FIELDS.NAME: Wanderlust Travel Agency
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Wanderlust Travel Agency specializes in providing tailored travel experiences for clients seeking both leisure and adventure. Our core operations involve the organization of domestic and international travel packages, including air travel, accommodations, rental services, and guided tours. We prioritize customer satisfaction by offering personalized itineraries based on individual preferences and budgets. Our team of experienced travel consultants is committed to conducting thorough risk assessments for all destinations, ensuring that clients are informed of travel advisories and safety measures. Additionally, we maintain robust cybersecurity protocols to protect client information and train our employees annually on data security practices. All vendor partnerships are with reputable companies, and we have a written incident response plan in place, which strengthens our commitment to client safety and data protection.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in unregulated adventure tours in politically unstable or sanctioned regions and confirms that it adheres to all necessary compliance measures. We maintain robust cybersecurity protocols, including up-to-date firewall and antivirus protections, and conduct annual employee cybersecurity training, with all sessions documented accordingly. Additionally, our agency has no history of unresolved or multiple data breaches, ensuring a secure operational environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a data breach occurred due to outdated security software, resulting in unauthorized access to client information. The estimated cost of remediation, including security updates and customer notifications, was $1,500. Status: Resolved. On 05/05/2022, $500 was lost due to a fraudulent charge related to a client's travel booking. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sundays.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm monitoring and security patrols during business hours.
